evidence.record_quote: The Books3 component of the dataset contains copyrighted material compiled from Bibliotik, a piracy website.
In July 2023, the Danish anti-piracy group Rights Alliance took down Books3 through DMCA notices.
Books3 was removed from the Pile before a class action lawsuit was filed in 2024 by three authors seeking damages as copies of the original dataset were still copied and available on the web.
